name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Frosted Acrylic Plaque with Pine Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from premium 3 mm frosted acrylic with a smooth, semi-transparent finish for a modern and elegant appearance.
    - Paired with a sturdy natural pine wooden base, available in 4-inch or 6-inch lengths depending on the plaque size.
    - Precision-cut acrylic edges provide a clean, polished look while ensuring long-lasting durability.
    - Optional printed or unprinted wooden base to match your preferred design style.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available plaque sizes:
            +) 4 × 6 in ~ 10.16 × 15.24 cm
            +) 6 × 6 in ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
            +) 6 × 8 in ~ 15.24 × 20.32 cm
            +) 8 × 8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
            +) 8 × 10 in ~ 20.32 × 25.40 cm
    - Pine wooden base:
            +) 4 × 2 × 0.79 in ~ 10.16 × 5.1 × 2 cm
            +) 6 × 2 × 0.79 in ~ 15.24 × 5.1 × 2 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - High-definition UV printing for vibrant, long-lasting colors.
    - Available with one-sided or double-sided printing.
    - For double-sided printing, artwork or text may overlap in transparent areas due to the see-through material.
    - Adding a solid background helps minimize the overlap effect.
    - White text is not recommended on double-sided designs, as it may appear less visible.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Freestanding design makes it perfect for displaying on desks, shelves, mantels, countertops, reception tables, or event displays.
    - Ideal as a personalized table number, wedding sign, memorial plaque, family keepsake, baby announcement, or home décor piece.
    - Sturdy wooden base securely holds the acrylic plaque while allowing easy assembly without additional tools.
    - A stylish decorative accent for homes, offices, weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, and special celebrations.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, birthdays, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, and many other special occasions.
    - Perfect for couples, newlyweds, family members, friends, coworkers, or anyone who appreciates meaningful custom décor.
    - Personalize it with names, photos, meaningful quotes, or special dates to create a unique keepsake that celebrates life's most treasured moments.
    - Designed to become a lasting display piece that preserves precious memories and adds a warm, personal touch to any space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 - 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Frosted Acrylic Plaque with Pine Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1 - 0.3  cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
